mentions.name: Skill capsules
mentions.description: This ML experiment implements "skill capsules" for LLMs: capsules are cheaply extracted from successful episodes (as little as a single episode) and then applied to improve success on similar tasks, framed as a "poor man's continual learning" approach.
mentions.source_excerpt:
ML experiment: "skill capsules" for LLM. Capsules can be cheaply extracted from successful episodes (as little as a single episode) and then applied to improve success of similar tasks.

I see it as a "poor man's continual learning".
